name: Barrio X3
description: Barrio X3 (also known as Barrio 13) is a Sureños street gang based in South Los Angeles, founded in the early 1970s near El Segundo Boulevard and San Pedro Street. The gang is divided into West Side and East Side factions, with members loyal to the Mexican Mafia. It is involved in narcotics trafficking, homicide, and human trafficking, and has expanded its presence across Southern California and into Tijuana, Rosarito, and Tecate, Mexico.
